summary: Budibase is a self-hosted low-code application-builder platform on CouchDB: it stores per-tenant app workspaces (tables, rows, views, screens, automations, webhooks), global users/groups/roles/configs, AI agents/requests/chat, audit logs, backups/deployments and OAuth2/plugin metadata, all written and read back through Koa REST controllers on the server and worker packages.

_no_edges.why: internal event-processor write path (AuditLogsProcessor.ts), no HTTP route, no auth wall, calls only db.put on its own entity
internal SDK op called by Agent.remove; no route of its own, no auth wall (files.ts:115)

_dropped.reason: runs a CSV-to-JSON converter outside the DB; no verifiable effect.
executes an external query and returns its rows; the only emitted event lands on an internal log, no verifiable insert.
same external-query runner as query_execute; no verifiable effect.
runs a query against an external source and merges a preview schema; no verifiable row change.
runs an OpenAPI/REST importer through the SDK, creating datasources+queries implicitly; the only declared insert lands on Datasource with a fabricated panel.
streams a backup archive as a file blob; no verifiable effect.
reads a single deployment entry out of a JSON history blob; effectively covered by fetch_deployments.
merges arbitrary JSON via an updateFn over a kernel key; the panel is unverifiable.
peripheral scratchpad entity, not part of the app-building surface (kept create-less for navigation edit/delete coherence).
duplicates the peripheral workspace-app scratchpad; low value, kept out.
